title: The Little AI Helper
pages: The Little AI Helper. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] A story about using AI the right way. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Part of Get Set Go Series.
It was a sunny day. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Peep and Poppy were attending their school.

We're having a project competition! [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Make something wonderful using paper and bring it to school tomorrow. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Wow! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] I can't wait! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Be creative! Have fun!

That afternoon, Peep and Poppy sat at the kitchen table. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Paper, crayons and coloured pencils were everywhere. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] I know! I'll make an aeroplane! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] And I'll make a paper cat!

Peep folded his paper one way, then another. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] It didn't look like an aeroplane at all. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Poppy tried making two little ears. Her paper cat kept falling over. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Oh dear, said Peep. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] We know what to make... [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] but not how to make it!

Mama Clover came into the kitchen. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Why don't you ask an AI helper to show you how? [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] An AI helper? asked Poppy. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Mama Clover brought over her tablet. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] It can explain things and help you learn how to do them. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Hello! I can help you learn and make amazing things!

With Mama Clover beside them, Peep asked: [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] How can I make a paper aeroplane? [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Poppy asked: [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] How can I make a paper cat? [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Step-by-step instructions appeared on the tablet. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Look! said Peep. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] It can teach us!

Peep carefully followed the instructions. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Fold the paper in half. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Now fold the corners. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Next, make the wings. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Fold... [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Press... [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Turn... [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] There! cried Peep. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] He held up his very own paper aeroplane.

Poppy followed her instructions too. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Fold... [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Turn... [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Fold again... [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Then she added two ears, bright eyes, whiskers and a little pink nose. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] My cat is finished! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] It looks brilliant! said Peep.

Mama Clover looked at their projects. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] The AI helper showed you the steps, she said. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] But who folded the paper? [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] We did! said Peep and Poppy. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Who chose the colours and decorations? [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] We did! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Mama Clover smiled. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Exactly.

The next morning, everyone brought their projects to school. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] There were paper boats, flowers, houses and animals. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Peep placed his aeroplane on the table. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Poppy carefully placed her cat beside it. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Professor Ollie looked at all the wonderful creations.

Professor Ollie smiled. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Our winners are... [sPause time="0.5s" ePause] Peep and Poppy! [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] Hooray! [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] Everyone clapped. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] We had a little help learning how, said Poppy. [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] But we made them ourselves! added Peep proudly.

Remember kids, [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] AI can show you how. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] You still think, [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] create and do! [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] And when you're young, use AI with a trusted grown-up.
Lesson of the story is [sPause time="0.35s" ePause] AI can help us learn. [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] But you still need to think, [sPause time="0.3s" ePause] create and do!
